svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step two separate metal shapes stand on a flat pale oxide over a buried level of metal: a line at the left and a wider one at the right carrying a raised thin purple plate. After it a thick pale oxide fills the gap between them and buries both, its top higher over the metal than over the gap.

svg.text: Before: the metal-4 line and second capacitor (step 155)
A silicon dioxide is deposited over the metal lines and
the capacitor plates, filling the gaps between them.
After: the inter-metal oxide over the metal
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
